packet: H6a ordered resource pairs and entered currency exchange
scope: exchange_pair is keyed by authorization owner, economic entity, and ordered given/received resource identities. Identical resources reject; inverse orientation is a separately stored pair.

cash_exchange executes currency-to-currency pairs only. It requires positive entered amounts at each currency precision, correctly oriented treasury accounts, and matching pair/account/execution entity and owner. Given currency is debited and received currency credited once; pair history records both entered quantities.

cash_exchange_reversal is a separate optional full reversal, at most one per source. Its treasury legs and swapped amounts derive from the source. Pair history subtracts the original oriented given/received source quantities. Equality with source effective time is accepted.

Pair reported rate is a read-only SELECT projection of net entered received sum divided by net entered given sum when the denominator is positive; it is NONE at zero denominator. Quote rows do not enter pair history.
Item and service pair identities are accepted for identity-only use. Their execution, conversion, fees, quote-derived execution, and production migration are not covered.

probe.output: Accounting H6a ordered pairs, entered currency exchange, asymmetric full reversals, rate projection, atomicity, and source-row oracles passed
checks: Same-resource and duplicate ordered pair writes reject atomically. Two independent Surreal client sessions race duplicate pair creation; exactly one succeeds and one loses to the unique index. Inverse, other-entity, and same-entity/different-owner pairs are permitted as distinct identities.
JPY-to-USD execution verifies precision-zero entered quantity; fractional precision-zero and fractional USD amounts, zero amounts, and item/service execution reject.
Two same-time USD-to-EUR exchanges are inserted in reverse lexical ID order. Treasury balances, complete-time floors, and pair totals match independent row reconstructions.
Wrong orientation, economic entity, and pair owner reject atomically. A treasury floor failure rolls back both treasury legs and the pair-history contribution.
A quote remains in currency_exchange with zero usage and no contribution to entered pair history.

An asymmetric 100 USD / 90 EUR execution is fully reversed. The oracle proves pair history subtracts original source orientation while reversal treasury legs use the inverse amounts. Duplicate and before-source reversals reject.

A typed source_effective_at dependency makes a source date edit that would predate its reversal reject with full snapshot equality. Equality is accepted. A valid source amount edit refreshes derived reversal legs and leaves pair and treasury roots correct.

A June 2 tree-before query is compared with a source-row oracle. Reversal rekey, reversal delete/re-add with stable ID, execution delete/re-add, and fully reversed zero-denominator projection are checked.

Independent row oracles reconstruct every treasury sum and complete-time minimum, each pair's oriented net quantities, as-of pair quantities, and the ratio projection. Failed writes compare full snapshots including facts and both treasury roots.

commands.result: passed with two-client pair uniqueness race

limits: The all-in-accounting compiler rejects a self-derived dependency on exchange_pair.z_history because it is not a typed record reference. The rate therefore remains a read-only query projection over the maintained pair summary, not a materialized field.
Only SurrealDB 3.2.0 disposable-profile behavior was exercised. Item/service execution, H6b quote-derived execution, fees, partial reversals, and production migration remain unverified.
